headerDisplay: LG ThinQ appliances in Apple Home through LG's official ThinQ Connect API. Create a personal access token at [connect-pat.lgthinq.com](https://connect-pat.lgthinq.com) (choose your country at the top first, then sign in) with every device permission ticked, and paste it below. Washers and dryers are supported; other LG appliances can be tried with "Experimental appliances".
footerDisplay: Problems or a new appliance to add? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zmanuel1234/homebridge-lg-thinq-connect/issues).

token.title: Personal access token
token.description: From connect-pat.lgthinq.com, signed in with the LG account your appliances are on. Keep it private.

country.title: Country of your LG account
country.description: Two-letter code, such as US, CA, GB or DE. LG keeps accounts on a server per region.

allowControl.title: Allow starting and pausing from the Home app
allowControl.description: Tapping the machine's tile starts, pauses or resumes it. LG only accepts this after Remote Start is pressed on the machine. Off: the tile only shows the cycle.

experimental.title: Experimental appliances
experimental.description: Also add LG appliances not yet confirmed on real hardware: air conditioners, fridges, dishwashers, dehumidifiers, air purifiers and more (see the README). If you try one, please report how it works on GitHub.

extraControls.title: Extra switches for experimental appliances
extraControls.description: Switches for what an appliance offers beyond its main tile: air conditioner air purify, energy saving, display light, the other swing direction, jet, dry and fan modes, airflow styles; air purifier sleep mode and turbo; AeroTower warm mode, UV nano and display light; humidifier auto, sleep, hygiene dry, warm mist, mood lamp and display light; water heater modes; cooktop "all burners off". Turn off for a tidier Home app. (Fridge and wine cellar settings such as express modes, power saving and the light are always added.)

liveUpdates.title: Live updates from LG
liveUpdates.description: LG sends changes and alerts (cycle complete, drying failed) the moment they happen. Scheduled checks continue as a backup. Turn off only if live updates cause problems.

energy.title: Energy use in the Eve app
energy.description: This month's energy use, for appliances LG reports it for, shown in the Eve app (Apple's Home app doesn't show energy). LG updates it with a delay, often a day.

phaseSensors.title: Phase sensors
phaseSensors.description: Adds a sensor that is on during the chosen phase, for automations (for example, turn on a fan while spinning). Only phases a machine reports are added.

oneOf.title: Main phase (washing, or drying on a dryer)

tubCleanAfter.title: Tub clean reminder after (cycles)
tubCleanAfter.description: Adds a "tub clean" sensor to washers that count their cycles. It turns on when LG's count reaches this number (LG suggests a Tub Clean about every 30 washes); turn on notifications for it. 0 = no reminder.

ignore.title: Leave out these appliances
ignore.description: Names exactly as in the ThinQ app.

appliances.title: Options per appliance
appliances.description: For one appliance, by its name exactly as in the ThinQ app.

extraControls.title: Extra switches
extraControls.description: Overrides the setting above for this appliance.

acModes.title: Air conditioner: modes on the tile

acSwing.title: Air conditioner: the tile's swing moves

temperatureSensor.title: Air conditioner: room temperature sensor
temperatureSensor.description: The room temperature as a sensor of its own, for automations.

pollInterval.title: Check every (seconds, idle)
pollInterval.description: How often to ask LG for each appliance's state while nothing is running.

runningPollInterval.title: Check every (seconds, during a cycle)
runningPollInterval.description: How often to ask during a cycle, so time left and the end are up to date.
